naslov: External sandbox for coding agents: run AI code without leaking keys | AI Tool #22
opis:
The agent runs on your machine, while the code it executes runs in a separate sandbox (Alpine Linux in WebAssembly, Apple Containers or QEMU). It also comes with an allowlist proxy and secret-key substitution, so the agent never sees your keys.

How to try it:
1. On a Mac, open the external-sandbox-container repo (uses Apple Containers) or external-sandbox-v86 (Node.js).
2. Start the server following the README, and you get a local API.
3. In Claude Code or Codex, configure it to send commands to that localhost API instead of executing them directly.
4. In the proxy UI, add only the domains the agent is allowed to call (e.g. your Supabase project).

Price: free

Official link: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/17/external-sandboxes-for-coding-agents/

naslov: ffmpeg-skill: let Claude Code edit your videos locally with FFmpeg | AI Tool #23
opis:
A local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools and an MCP server. The agent cuts footage, adds subtitles, makes a vertical 9:16 format and evens out audio levels, all locally, with no cloud and no API keys.

How to try it:
1. Install FFmpeg (brew install ffmpeg).
2. Run npx ffmpeg-skill and follow the instructions to connect it to Claude Code as a skill or MCP server.
3. Ask Claude something like "cut the silences from video.mp4 and make a 9:16 version with subtitles".

Price: free

Official link: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill

naslov: What is prompt caching? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Prompt caching means an AI model saves the work it already did on the start of your prompt, so repeated prompts are processed faster and billed at a lower "cached input" price. Example: OpenAI's new GPT-6.2 Astra just cut its cached input price from $1 to $0.40 per million tokens, while fresh input costs $8.
